module_title: Intermediate Framework - Gender Quotas, Municipal Corporations, and Historic Firsts
introduction: This level targets localized administrative rules, the statutory distribution of urban local bodies, and critical historical personalities that dominate political GK questions in state boards.

core_concepts.title: Women's Reservation in Panchayats
core_concepts.description: Uttar Pradesh mandates a minimum of **one-third (33.33% or 1/3)** reservation of total seats for women across all tiers of Panchayati Raj (Gram, Kshetra, and Zila levels). (Note: While some states like Bihar have raised this to 50%, UP strictly retains the 1/3 structural quota).

core_concepts.title: Urban Local Bodies (ULB) Hierarchy
core_concepts.description:
Urban areas are structurally split into 3 tiers based on population demographics:
- **Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam):** For heavy metropolitan clusters (population > 5 Lakh). UP contains exactly **17 Municipal Corporations**.
- **Municipal Council (Nagar Palika Parishad):** For medium-sized cities and towns.
- **Town Area Committee (Nagar Panchayat):** For transitional zones moving from rural to urban economies.

core_concepts.title: Pioneering Political Icons of UP
core_concepts.description:
- **First Chief Minister:** Pandit Govind Ballabh Pant.
- **First Female Chief Minister:** Sucheta Kripalani (Historically notable as the first female CM of *any* Indian state).
- **First Female Governor:** Sarojini Naidu (Also notable as the first female Governor of any Indian state).
- **First Assembly Speaker:** Rajarshi Purushottam Das Tandon.

important_entities.name: Shahjahanpur
important_entities.significance: Following the creation of Mathura-Vrindavan (15th) and Ayodhya (16th), **Shahjahanpur** was officially notified as the **17th and newest Municipal Corporation** of Uttar Pradesh in 2018. This is a highly tested entity in RO/ARO papers.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Voting Age vs. Candidacy Age in Local Polls
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Students frequently apply the assembly candidacy bar to panchayats:
- Minimum age to cast a vote ➡️ **18 Years**.
- Minimum age required to contest election for Gram Pradhan/Panchayat member ➡️ **21 Years** (NOT 25).
- Minimum age to become an MLA ➡️ 25 Years.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: UP gave India its first lady CM (Sucheta) and first lady Governor (Sarojini).
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Associates these two massive national historic milestones directly with Uttar Pradesh's administrative legacy.

exam_strategy_tips: In RO/ARO and UPPSC Prelims, statement-based questions often test the 21-year age qualification for Panchayat heads or ask you to spot the 17th Municipal Corporation. Pay absolute attention to these details.
